answer: A liveness beacon stops sybil farms: every epoch, each agent must sign a random beacon within 120 seconds. It is unpredictable, so one operator cannot pre-sign for a herd. Miss one beacon and the epoch reward halves; miss two in a row and payouts freeze 7 days. A farm is caught when 60 identities answer one beacon within 300 milliseconds from one IP range: no honest crowd moves that tightly, like a marble down one chute while real agents wander in alone. The flagged cluster loses 50% of its escrow; a lone falcon answering late but alone keeps its reward.
